comment: shk.c block_entry(): a Samurai carrying a wished pick-axe stands on the broken door of a Dlvl 4 general store whose shopkeeper is at home, then steps diagonally into the shop. The shop is room index 0, so its room number is 3, and C's IS_SHOP(roomno) at shk.c:5837 reads svr.rooms[3], an ordinary room: block_entry() returns FALSE and the hero walks in without "blocks your way!". ^V 4 reaches the level, ^T places the hero east of the door (the two spaces dismiss the prompt's --More-- and the getpos tip), the pick-axe is wished before stepping onto the door so the shopkeeper returns home to block it, and #wizwish "broken door" sets D_BROKEN on the hero's doorway. The final s lets the shopkeeper react to the hero inside.
